prompt: In my Ableton Live extension (@ableton-extensions/sdk), I want this: the user makes a time selection across one or more MIDI tracks in the Arrangement, right-clicks, and picks "Fill With Clips". That should create an empty MIDI clip on every selected MIDI track/lane spanning exactly the selected time range — and the whole thing must be a single undo step. Write the complete src/extension.ts.
assertions: Entry point: exports activate and calls initialize(activation, "1.0.0")
Resolves lanes with getObjectFromHandle and narrows with instanceof
Creates clips with positional createMidiClip(startTime, duration) — not an object arg
Single undo step via withinTransaction(() => Promise.all(...)) — no beginUndoStep/manual undo
